criteria.hint: What I understood. Tap a criterion to remove it.

closed.one: shows up in older recommendations, but seems to have closed. I left it out.
closed.many: show up in older recommendations, but seem to have closed. I left them out.

people.note: You only ask the most relevant people, not your whole contact list.

errors.ask: I couldn’t understand the question. Try again in a moment.
errors.search: I can’t search your circle right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.generic: Something got stuck. Try again in a moment.
errors.booking: I can’t save your booking. Try again in a moment.

replies.notReusable: {name} didn’t allow reuse: this answer only serves this question and won’t be kept.
replies.changesRanking: I have a new, more reliable recommendation: their answer changes the ranking.

empty.title: Where should you really go?
empty.lead: Ask like you’d ask a friend. I look at what your circle knows first, then fill in with public info.
empty.saveHint: You can also paste a Google Maps, Instagram or TikTok link: I’ll keep the place in your memory.

ask.unauthenticated: Sign in to ask a question.
ask.invalid: The question is missing or too long.
ask.notConfigured: WH3RE isn’t set up to understand questions yet.
ask.unparseable: I couldn’t understand the question. Could you rephrase it?
ask.rateLimited: Too many questions at once. Try again in a moment.
ask.unreachable: I can’t reach my engine. Try again in a moment.
ask.upstream: My engine gave a garbled answer. Try again in a moment.

search.unauthenticated: Sign in to run a search.
search.memory: I can’t read your memory right now. Try again in a moment.

conversations.unauthenticated: Sign in to ask a question.

api.quotaExceeded: You’ve asked a lot of questions today. Pick it up tomorrow: your memory and your circle are still here.

save.unauthenticated: Sign in to keep a place.
save.readFailed: I can’t read this link right now. Try again in a moment.
save.saveFailed: I can’t keep this place right now. Try again in a moment.

save.found: I found this place. Keep it in your memory?
save.saved: Done: {name} is in your memory. You now have {count, plural, one {# place} other {# places}} there.
save.notFound: I couldn’t spot a specific place in this link. Try the place’s Google Maps link.
save.failed: I couldn’t keep it. Try again in a moment.
save.instagram: Instagram doesn’t let its posts be read without an account. Send the link again with the place’s name next to it, or its Google Maps link.
